text:
Camille: Quick intake: want to bring up sable-13b-smol through the new onboarding. Goals: 4-bit quant baseline, chat template with tool calling, strictly-validated JSON outputs for downstream evals.

Mike: +1. Baseline runs: fp16 perf + accuracy, then quant matrix. Suggest a slim chat template rather than tilt13b's full context.

Satya: Proposed minimal chat skeleton:
```
SYSTEM: You are a structured assistant. Final assistant message must be pure JSON with keys {answer, sources, tool_calls}.
USER: {user_text}
```
Assistant intermediate messages may be plain text; final must be JSON.

Olivia: Tool_call shape we expect:
```
"tool_calls": [
  {"tool_name":"kb_search","args":{"query":"..."},"result":"..."}
]
```
Downstream eval extracts tool_calls[].result for retrieval precision.

Camille: Quant plan: run q4_s and q4_a, kv-fold true/false. Command:
```
python infra/quant_run.py --model sable-13b-smol --modes q4_s,q4_a --kvfold true,false --batch 8 --log /tmp/quant-sable-<runid>.json
```
Include hardware tags and runid in log.

Mike: Capture latency and token-level accuracy. Eval command:
```
python evals/run_prompt_suite.py --model ./runs/<runid> --suite chat-format-struct.json --metrics p50,p95,token_acc,f1
```
Flag: if F1 drop > 3% vs fp16, mark regression.

Satya: Watch hallucination rate. Add adversarial prompt perturbations.

Olivia: Add 6 canonical prompt examples that use markdown and unicode, and exercise tool calls to reduce parsing flakiness.

eval-bot: AUTO: queued job 20260320-ev-42 for run q-sable-20260320-1. Will post results.

Camille: Need runtime config: "final_output_only": true for chat endpoints and server-side schema validation prior to ingestion.

Mike: I'll add validate_struct_output(schema, payload) in eng-runtime. On mismatch return 400 + diag tags.

Satya: Camille, can you draft a 1-pager for prompt contract (minimal template + tool_call schema)? :memo: 

Camille: On it. Timeline:
- fp16 baseline by EOD
- quant matrix + eval tomorrow
- schema validator PR this week

Olivia: pinging @deploy-bot for a canary pool for q4 runs :eyes:

deploy-bot: INFO: Canary pool "sable-canary" reserved 4h starting 2026-03-20T15:00Z.

Camille: Assigning owners and will drop the draft + runids here. Anyone up for pairing on JSON schema examples later?

Mike: I can pair 4pm PT.

Satya: I'll set eval thresholds and review results.

Camille: Thanks — will post FP16 logs and run ids when ready. :rocket:
